# Story long analyze: deep structural breakdown of long Chinese web novels

Curated by Skill Harbor — @zenstory-ai's deep novel-deconstruction skill: it turns a long web novel into per-chapter facts, plot units, character profiles, pacing analyses and a reusable style profile, through a staged pipeline — Stage 0 mechanical chapter index (with sha256 checksums and re-run guards), Stage 1 "golden three chapters" deep dive, Stage 2 batched chapter extraction (subagents, 3 batches per round, resume support), Stage 3 plot, dual timelines and 3D rhythm, Stage 4 characters, settings and relationship graphs, Stage 5 master report, Stage 6 style profile — plus an optional three-layer inspiration library pipeline (per-book atoms, cross-book aggregation, controlled-tag library updates). Hard analysis boundaries: only conclude from readable text ("unknown" when missing), attach chapter locators to hard facts, separate objective event order from reader knowledge, never migrate proprietary settings or copy iconic scenes — migrate abstract mechanics only. Author-facing outputs (快速预览.md, 拆文报告.md, character graphs) are written in plain language, free of script names, field names or internal filenames, with resume/checkpoint support via `_progress.md` and state scripts (`manage_analysis_run.py`). Honest caveats: **the skill is written in Chinese and targets Chinese web-fiction workflows** (chapter naming, story mechanics and the companion `story-long-scan` skill assume that tradition); a full-novel run is a long multi-stage operation — expect heavy token use and...
